name: m2-01-multilingual-retrieval-labels-v2.1
description: Human-adjudicated revision of the v2 fixed corpus for comparing literal and semantic retrieval. Labels were checked against the stored page text and the original questions; model-generated answers were not used to choose them. `relevant` lists exact page-text sentences that directly answer the question; an empty list marks an unanswerable query. `irrelevant` documents near-miss candidates used to audit distractor behaviour. Unanswerable queries are excluded from Recall@K and reported separately.

category_legend.zh_to_en: Chinese question whose supporting evidence is English source text.
category_legend.en_paraphrase: English question whose wording differs from the stored evidence.
category_legend.cross_page: The answer requires evidence from more than one page.
category_legend.partial_candidates: Several topically related candidates exist but only some truly support the question.
category_legend.keyword_distractor: A shared keyword pulls in candidates that do not answer the question.
category_legend.different_conclusion: A similar topic carries a different or opposite conclusion.
category_legend.unanswerable: No sentence in the document answers the question; excluded from Recall@K.
category_legend.recall_vs_top1: At least one lexical distractor can outrank the sole supporting span, so Recall@5 and Top-1 can disagree.
